content.short: NOWNodes provides API access to full nodes and blockbook explorers across 100+ blockchain networks.
content.description: NOWNodes is a blockchain-as-a-service platform that provides API access to full nodes and blockbook explorers. The service provides a high-quality infrastructure that is fast, cost-effective, and reliable, and it offers Service Quality Standards for all partners. Choose the node you need, use the available methods, and connect.

resources.title: What Is the EVM?
resources.tldr: Every swap, mint and loan runs code somewhere. That somewhere is the Ethereum Virtual Machine, which turns out to sit under most of Web3.

resources.title: What Is a DAO?
resources.tldr: A group that pools money and decides by code and member vote, not a board. Rules live in a contract, the treasury is visible, no one moves funds alone.

resources.title: What Is a DEX?
resources.tldr: Swapping one asset for another straight from your own wallet, with no company holding funds or approving the trade. Code executes it, not a support desk.
